content: Ripyu̱cheda japu Pyidátubamyuju̱ni̱ Jesús

Ra̱sacharamu ruuvaayada caserdótevyeda nutyityu̱mirya tu̱choda, rimyityumitya, Ju̱denu niquejada datyanuvatya jarye, jiryatiy nusu̱vye ti̱ta̱ju̱ riy. Jadchiy ji̱ta ripyuchodani̱ Jesús variy; ripyu̱cheda jadchiñi̱, riche̱yada variy Pyidátubañi̱.
Sitaja̱doda ji̱ta Pyidátubañi̱: “¿Jiñi̱ta Judíyuveda ja̱mu nutyityu̱ ji?” Su̱mutya̱jada Jesús variñi̱: “Jityi jtay daryadacyu̱.”
Rityu̱chutanu̱yada caserdótevyeda nutyityu̱miy rajuuranchiñi̱.
Sajatyiiyada ji̱ta jtaja̱doda Pyidátubantyiñi̱: “¿Ne yimutya̱ru̱dye? ¿Ne yinu̱y rajuuranchiy rityu̱chuta ji?”
Ne su̱mutya̱ru̱yada Jesús tara variñu̱day. Sati̱tta̱da Pyidátubay variñi̱.
Pyidátubay sa̱yada crusitya̱sa jvatyadedaju̱ni̱ Jesús
Nu̱ñi vichtya rundamu ru̱mu̱ryanu̱yadani̱ ju̱richi̱, jiryatiy rivya̱tanu̱yada Pyidátubavyani̱ ju̱richi̱.

Ju̱richavay cabyimu ji̱ta savichanu̱yada ti̱qui nijya̱mi̱, Barába jtyati̱bay. Varityi riñubesubeda nijya̱nvay, ma̱myi nusu̱yada jiyaro̱ju̱, su̱veda Barábabañi̱ nijya̱mi̱. Ni̱ni̱ vichanu̱yada variy tanuvu̱nujovimu.
Ru̱deda ji̱ta nijya̱nvajyuu variy simu Pyidátubay, rijyo̱ta̱da jachiñu̱yada variy siva: “Ya̱jmu̱ryani̱ ju̱richi̱, tapi nu̱ñi dajitya yimu̱ryasarani̱ ju̱richi̱ vichtya rundamu.”
Su̱mutya̱jada ji̱ta Pyidátubay variryi: “¿Jiryevya̱taviy ra̱jmu̱rya jiryejyu̱ni̱ Judíyuveda ja̱mu nutyityu̱?”
Tapi sadatyanu̱yadatya Pyidátubay daryaju̱: rivani̱day riche̱ñu̱yada caserdótevyeda nutyityu̱miñi̱ Jesús, jiryatiy samirya ridyiryejada nijya̱nvay daryaju̱ dañi̱.
Rirya̱tachunu̱yada caserdótevyeda nutyityu̱miryi nijya̱nvay variy, rirya̱tidye jachiñu̱y siva Pyidátubarya: “Ya̱jmu̱ryani̱ Barába, Jesús ju̱bivaju̱.”
Su̱teda ji̱ta Pyidátubay jadchiy ruuvantiy: “¿Nu̱tyuna̱ jiryi̱tay ra̱chaniñi̱ jiñu nijya̱mi̱, nu̱tyu? jiryatiy jiryeñi jtay Judíyuveda ja̱mu nutyityu̱ntiñi̱.”
Riche̱ñe̱ya̱jada ji̱ta varintyi: “Ya̱ni jvay crusitya̱sani̱.”
Su̱teda ji̱ta Pyidátubay variy ruuvantiy: “¿Ta̱raju̱ra? ¿Ta̱ra sivaay nicyara̱y, ta̱ra?” Jaryiñuma riche̱ñe̱ya̱jada ji̱tate varidye: “Ya̱ni jvay crusitya̱sateni̱.”
Jadchiy ji̱ta jiryatiy sani jchana̱churu̱yada Pyidátubay rata riy, su̱mu̱rya̱da ji̱ta variñi̱ Barába rijyu̱. Samusityadedanumatiy variñi̱ Jesús, sasa̱yada ji̱ta varintyiñi̱, crusitya̱sa jvacha̱daju̱.
Samusiye̱cha̱divasiy rirya̱rupanta̱da Jesúsyu
Ripyu̱cheda ji̱ta su̱tarumiñi̱ Jesús japu roriy vatapadamuju̱. Jadchiy ji̱ta riñatuyada riy ti̱ta̱ju̱ yisa̱ vichavay variy.
Rijechoda ji̱ta su̱tarumiy sivantirya vadacudijajyuuntiy, jadchiy ji̱ta richa̱da sanuviiju̱ cariituju̱u̱musiy, ribeyada su̱no̱mu varirya.
Rijyo̱ta̱da mu̱chuveda variñi̱ Jesús: “¡Sa̱ma̱ jnu̱chara ta̱rijyu̱ Judíyuveda ja̱mu nutyityu̱!”
Ru̱vatyiyada ji̱ta tancheduta su̱no̱va, rityochiye̱yada variy siva, rirya̱dasidyoda variy satuunuyu, nu̱tyu riñi tuva̱chu nta yitay variy simu.

Rirya̱rupantamu̱yadanumatiñi̱, rimerchoda ji̱ta variy sivasirya vadacudijajyuu, rijechoda varirya sasujay yivantiy. Ru̱veda yivamyurota crusitya̱sani̱ Jesús (Matévu 27.32-44; Dúcasiy 23.26-43; Juán 19.17-27) Rirya̱ra̱yada ji̱ta bimuju̱ni̱ jasityi rirya̱jvay crusitya̱sani̱.
Rinchutadeda ji̱ta variy crusiñi̱ ti̱qui vanu jiryatiy saramiryi̱ variy yindimyusiy. Ni̱ni̱day Siréne mucadimusi̱, jiryatiy Siimyó̱ jtyati̱bañi̱. Ni̱ni̱ vichanu̱yada Adejántrubay ja̱be, Rújubatyá.
Rirya̱ra̱yadani̱ Jesús ravichajomuju̱, jiryatiy Córucota jtyatarara, jiryatiy ru̱teda Nijya̱mi̱ Jno̱siiy Vichajora.
Ru̱ntatyaja̱jada variy sivara bínuja̱, myírata jaryedo; ne su̱mutya̱jadara.
Ru̱veda ji̱ta yivamyurota crusitya̱sa variñi̱. Riñantaja̱jada ji̱ta su̱tarumiy variy yivara Jesús sujay, nu̱tyu riñi tiyi̱sa rata, chi̱ju̱ra ra̱ma̱cho̱ Jesús sujatye, chi̱ju̱.
Vasetuunu jiñi̱ta ru̱veda yivamyurota crusitya̱sani̱ Jesús.
Jiryatirya ranu̱chara ta̱riva ru̱veda crusitya̱sani̱ Jesús, ranuma rani̱cha sanu̱chara: “Judíyuveda ja̱mu nutyityu̱,” jiryatiy rityu̱chuta̱da daryaju̱ni̱.
Ru̱veda ji̱ta yivamyurota crusijyu̱tya̱sa nada danu̱ju̱y paranu̱ni̱ju̱ntyi, ti̱qui santyityudamyusiy, nu̱ntiy samidámyusiy.
Ruuto̱tadedama̱ ji̱ta jasirya ranu̱chara: “Nu̱tyu jamirya vichara ru̱tañi̱.”

Jiryatiy riryamiya̱nu̱yada nijya̱nvay rumu, rirya̱vityiye̱yadani̱, rimyichutyaja̱jada varirya yino̱, jiryatiy ru̱teda siva: “U̱ju̱, daryamuni̱day yiteda ya̱javatyara Ju̱denu roriy. Yiteda ji̱tantiy: Mumurundamimyusiy ra̱nubesumityanintyirya rorintyi.
Ya̱numa jantyuy jiñuberiy yiva, yimusama̱ta jiñuberiy rata̱sasiy crusiy.”

Darya ni̱day rivyichaniñu̱yada caserdótevyeda nutyityu̱mitya, Ju̱denu niquejada datyanuvatyani̱, jiryatiy rirya̱rupanta̱da daryaju̱ni̱: “Ti̱va ji̱ta sa̱ntyuñu̱yada day, tama̱ sa̱ntyuy yivantidyecyu̱, tama̱.

Sa̱numata jmusaniy jiñuberiy Crístu, Irayénu ja̱mu nutyityu̱ crusitya̱sasiyu, vurya̱jnu̱yasityecu̱, si̱tenu ni̱te, vurya̱tidye tuva̱chu variy simu.” Jiryatiy ru̱veda crusitya̱sa sisa̱ju̱ nada, nada jarye javityiye̱yada variñi̱ Jesús.
Jesús diiyadanchiy
Vase jiñi̱tanumatiy ravicha̱da, rajo̱ta̱da ji̱ta ji̱ñupuyada mucadiva ti̱ta̱ju̱ variy, ni̱nutijcha vichi̱tasa̱ra̱ju̱ ri̱ñupuyada.
Jadchiy ji̱ta, saniquejada Jesús jiche̱ñe̱ya̱jadamuntiy: “Elóy, Elóy, láma sabactáni.” Daryani̱ rani̱ jtadye: “Ye̱ye̱, Ye̱ye̱, ¿ta̱ju̱ra jityochirye, ta̱ju̱?”
Jasiy ranivye tevay rityi tuva̱chodara saniquejada, ru̱teda variy jadchiy: “U̱ju̱u̱, sanatuye̱ñumani̱ Edíyasiy.”

Sasiicheda ji̱ta ti̱qui nijya̱mi̱, saparodedara vasari̱juujay, bínu ju̱daja̱ta, sabayada ji̱ta tanchedujchara, su̱ntatya̱da variy sivara sa̱tidye riñirya, su̱teda ji̱ta variy: “Ra̱chamiy, vurya̱jnu̱y sa̱vidye jmusaniñuvi̱ Edíyasiñi̱.”
Jadchiy ji̱ta sasa̱ñe̱ya̱jada Jesús jaryi variy, satiijeya̱cheda tamitya variyu.
Jadchiy ji̱ta raseteda Ju̱denu rorivyimu mutanujay jache na̱vachiy, mucomuju̱, ¡roooy!
Saradeda ji̱ta taraqui pacha su̱tarumiy nutyityu̱ Jesúsjsa̱ra̱. Su̱nu̱yadanumatiy nu̱tyuramusiy satiijeya̱cheda Jesús tamityayu, su̱teda ji̱ta variy: “¡Si̱tenu Ju̱denu denuni̱ttarye, si̱tenu!”

Jasidye rivyicha̱da vatuntyi, ru̱nu̱yada ripyapusiy sana̱cho̱. Rivyicha̱da rityevay jasiy Maríya Mardánamusi̱bay, jadchiy ji̱ta runu̱ntyi da Maríyaju̱bentyi, Santiyácuju̱be nijyu̱vichi̱ jno̱dabay, Jusíbe jno̱dabay jarye risa̱ju̱nada, tamityanu̱y ji̱ta Sadumyídyaju̱be.

Riñi̱ jivye vatuy siityari̱nu̱yadani̱ Jesús, rirya̱tidye potyaniñi̱, Cadidéya mucadimutidye sani̱chanu̱yada variy. Jasidye rivyicha̱da ruvay vatuy ju̱na̱ntyi, rityi jnu̱ñu̱yada Jerusarí̱ vicha̱dasa̱ra̱ju̱ni̱.
Jesús jmuchusa̱danchiy

Jidyenumatiy ravicha̱da, jiryatiy jdutya̱da runda ravicha̱da varidye, jiryatiy ru̱tachara jiituyada runda jo̱ta̱da varintyirya, su̱deda ji̱ta Jusíbe variy, Arimatéya vicha̱damusi̱, jiryatiy nusu̱vye tenuni̱. Ni̱day nutuchara ra̱jiju̱ Ju̱denu nusu̱yadantiy. Dajiryundamuni̱ ji̱ta sabayada vanu sabuyasa̱yu, saya̱da variy Pyidátubamyu, sajachiñu̱yada ji̱ta variy sivara Jesús babyi.

Sati̱tta̱da Pyidátubay varirya, sajachipiya̱jada ji̱ta: “¿Si̱tenuni̱viy savicha̱siy diiñu Jesús?” Sanatutyadeda variñi̱ taraqui pacha su̱tarumiy nutyityu̱, sitaja̱doda ji̱ta variñi̱: “¿Diiñunuma viy?” “Jo.”
Sadatya̱danumatiy Pyidátubarya Jesús diiyada, su̱teda variy siva Jusíbe: “Ya̱numa jtu darya Jesús babyi day.”

Jadchiy ji̱ta sata̱ryu̱yada Jusíberya rajejyuu, su̱musadeda varirya Jesús babyi crusitya̱sasiy, sarayada ji̱ta variy rajejyuutara sababyi. Sajachunuvejada ji̱ta bapyovudivimura, ravichu̱nube jmuchuravimu, sasiichudoda variñi̱ ti̱qui ravichu̱ bapyovudimuju̱.
Su̱nu̱yada ji̱ta Maríya Mardánamusi̱bay variy rana̱cho̱, nu̱tyijirya sabayatera, nu̱tyijiy. Nanuvicha̱da jasintyi da Maríyaju̱bentyi, jiryatiy Jusíbe jno̱dabay nada.
